import unittest
from solution import ReleaseIndex, ReleaseDetail


class ReleaseTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.releases = [
            {"slug": "zeta", "headline": "Z", "body": "body", "published_at": 20,
             "state": "public", "meta": {"tags": ["z"]}},
            {"slug": "alpha", "headline": "A", "body": "a", "published_at": 20,
             "state": "public", "meta": {"tags": ["a"]}},
            {"slug": "draft", "headline": "D", "body": "d", "published_at": 30,
             "state": "draft"},
            {"slug": "old", "headline": "O", "body": "o", "published_at": 10,
             "state": "public"},
        ]

    def test_index_sort_filter_and_deep_copy(self):
        result = ReleaseIndex().render(self.releases)
        self.assertEqual([r["slug"] for r in result], ["alpha", "zeta", "old"])
        result[0]["meta"]["tags"].append("changed")
        self.assertEqual(self.releases[1]["meta"]["tags"], ["a"])
        self.assertEqual(ReleaseIndex().render([]), [])

    def test_detail_public_draft_and_missing(self):
        result = ReleaseDetail().render(self.releases, "zeta")
        self.assertEqual(result["headline"], "Z")
        result["meta"]["tags"].append("changed")
        self.assertEqual(self.releases[0]["meta"]["tags"], ["z"])
        for slug in ("draft", "missing"):
            with self.subTest(slug=slug):
                with self.assertRaises(KeyError) as caught:
                    ReleaseDetail().render(self.releases, slug)
                self.assertEqual(caught.exception.args, (slug,))

    def test_docstrings_describe_releases(self):
        for cls in (ReleaseIndex, ReleaseDetail):
            self.assertIsInstance(cls.__doc__, str)
            self.assertIn("release", cls.__doc__.lower())

    def test_malformed_and_duplicate_releases(self):
        valid = {"slug": "s", "headline": "h", "body": "", "published_at": 0, "state": "public"}
        malformed = [
            "bad", {**valid, "slug": ""}, {**valid, "headline": ""},
            {**valid, "body": 1}, {**valid, "published_at": True},
            {**valid, "state": "private"},
        ]
        for item in malformed:
            for renderer in (lambda rs: ReleaseIndex().render(rs),
                             lambda rs: ReleaseDetail().render(rs, "s")):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    renderer([item])
        duplicates = [valid, {**valid, "headline": "other"}]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ReleaseIndex().render(duplicates)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ReleaseDetail().render(duplicates, "s")
        for slug in ("", None):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                ReleaseDetail().render([valid], slug)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
